disorder-name.detail: MDD patients (EMBARC study) with primary DSM-IV MDD diagnosis; sertraline arm (n=102) and placebo arm (n=119) combined as a single clinical cohort.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "we only included the 287 MDD patients in the EMBARC study (37), aged between 18 and 65. ... 221 MDD patients available for our study. These valid 221 patients were randomly assigned to a sertraline treatment arm (n = 102) and a placebo treatment arm (n = 119)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: MDD patients exclusively from the EMBARC study (Establishing Moderators and Biosignatures of Antidepressant Response for Clinical Care), recruited across four study sites.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "we only included the 287 MDD patients in the EMBARC study (37), aged between 18 and 65"

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD calculated from sertraline arm (n=102, mean=38.6, SD=14.1 yr) and placebo arm (n=119, mean=37.5, SD=13.0 yr). Range 18–65 stated for overall MDD cohort.
age.supporting_text: "Age, yr: 38.6 (14.1) [Sertraline, N=102], 37.5 (13.0) [Placebo, N=119]" / "221 medicated MDD patients (aged 18-65)"

sex.detail: Combined from sertraline arm (males 32/102, 31.4%) and placebo arm (males 46/119, 38.7%). Female N derived as total N minus male N for each arm (sertraline: 70 females; placebo: 73 females). Percentages calculated from combined counts.
